walkthroughs.title: AXIS: first plot
walkthroughs.description: Open the example study, run it locally, and optionally install the full engine. Source stays on this machine (uploaded=0).

steps.title: Run Script
steps.description:
Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) or **AXIS: Run Script**. The AXIS Run channel logs `uploaded=0`. If Pyodide cannot start, a local subset still plots this example and shows its inputs.
[Run Script](command:axis.runScript)

steps.title: Optional: full local engine
steps.description:
Pyodide is a bars-in calculator. For Numba `compile`, sessions, and `optimize`, install the managed local backend. It ships its own wheel and can download a pinned Python 3.12 when needed.
[Install Local Engine](command:axis.engine.setup)

axis.telemetry.offline.description: Keep product telemetry off by default in IDE.

axis.engine.mode.markdownDescription: Engine selection. `auto` prefers the managed local engine when it is provisioned (or `axis.engine.local.command` is customised), else Pyodide when enabled, else remote `/run`. `local` starts the managed `pyne-backend` sidecar on loopback. `server` uses `#axis.engine.endpoint#`. `pyodide` forces the Wasm calculator.

axis.engine.endpoint.markdownDescription: PYNE Pro / engine base URL (no `/run` suffix). Defaults to loopback. Remote URLs require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`.

axis.engine.local.command.markdownDescription: Command for the managed local engine. Defaults to the `pyne-backend` console script from the `hoox-pyne-backend` wheel. For a checkout, use `python3` with args `-m backend`.

axis.engine.local.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#axis.engine.local.command#`. Example for a checkout: `["-m", "backend"]`.

axis.engine.local.cwd.markdownDescription: Working directory for the local engine (repo checkout). Empty runs from the extension host cwd.

axis.engine.local.python.markdownDescription: Python 3.10–3.13 executable used by **AXIS: Install Local Engine** to create the extension-owned venv under `globalStorage/pyne-engine`. Ignored once `axis.engine.local.command` points at an installed backend.

axis.engine.local.package.markdownDescription: pip package spec installed by **AXIS: Install Local Engine**. Use a local path, wheel, or private-index spec when `hoox-pyne-backend` is not on the default index (for example `/path/to/pynescript/packages/backend`).

axis.engine.local.allowDownload.markdownDescription: When the default `python3` is missing or outside 3.10–3.13, **AXIS: Install Local Engine** downloads a pinned standalone CPython 3.12 build (~50 MB, SHA-256 verified) from python-build-standalone into `globalStorage/pyne-runtime`. Disable for air-gapped machines and set `#axis.engine.local.python#` instead.

axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint.markdownDescription: When false (default), `axis.engine.endpoint` must be loopback (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1`) so the Pro Bearer key is not sent off-machine. **Application (user) scope only** — workspace settings cannot enable remote endpoints. Opt in only for trusted remote Pro hosts.

axis.engine.allowPyodide.markdownDescription: Local Pyodide 0.29.5 bars-in calculator (Wave 1 default **on**). Pyodide ships in the VSIX (`vendor/pyodide/0.29.5`); the host falls back to jsDelivr into `globalStorage` only when the bundle is missing. `ready` after a 1+1 smoke plus pynescript Runtime smoke (trusted hoox-pyne wheel). Source is **not** uploaded (`uploaded=0`). Numba/R2/cron are not available in Wasm. Set false to force remote `/run` only.

axis.engine.pyodideWheelUrl.markdownDescription: Optional `https://` or `file://` URL (or filesystem path) of a trusted `hoox-pyne` / pynescript `py3-none-any` wheel for Pyodide micropip. Empty uses `media/pyodide/` then sibling `pynescript/dist`. Wasm is never this setting.

axis.chart.historyBars.markdownDescription: Default OHLCV history window for new chart sessions and when the document omits a positive `historyBars`. Counts are clamped to **20000** (same as this maximum).

axis.chart.useMockBars.markdownDescription: When true, chart sessions and runs use deterministic mock/fixture bars (opt-in). Default **false** fetches real OHLCV from `axis.datafeed.url` (local axis-datafeed sidecar, default `http://127.0.0.1:5003`).

axis.datafeed.url.markdownDescription: Base URL for the local `@hoox-sh/axis-datafeed` sidecar (`GET /datafeed/ohlcv`). Defaults to loopback `:5003`. Remote URLs require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`.

axis.datafeed.source.markdownDescription: OHLCV history source. 'sidecar' (default) fetches from the local axis-datafeed sidecar at `axis.datafeed.url`. 'venue' fetches live/historical OHLCV directly from a venue via ccxt (default binance) without the sidecar. Venue fetching requires `ccxt` (`bun add ccxt`) to be installed; without it the chart reports `ccxt not available` and leaves the canvas empty.

axis.statusbar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the AXIS IDE statusbar item (HOOX logo) with a click popup of AXIS commands. Turn off to hide the item.

axis.profiler.enabled.markdownDescription: Time run stages (engine, paint, delta, step) and show in the AXIS statusbar popup.

axis.debug.adapter.markdownDescription: Bar debug adapter. 'executable' (default) runs the real out-of-process axis-bar DAP adapter (`out/debug/adapter.js`) over stdio. 'inline' keeps the in-process adapter for the extension host process. DAP type stays `axis-bar` (never `pyne`).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run vendor:pyodide && npm run compile
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:coverage:gate
scripts.test: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node out/test/runTest.js
